releases.notes:
Changes:
- Fix Taterwebz browsers loading every page twice. This means that sites like https://classic.minecraft.net/ now work!

Technical:
- Fix loading nonexistant JOGL natives
- Downgrade slf4j and upgrade xz
- Replace LinuxJVMEnvironment with our own impl based on JNA
- Remove Pandomium's library injection, as it doesn't work on Java 9+
- Add libprojectinception.so to fix CEF resource locating on Linux. It should work on any Linux distro that supports `LD_PRELOAD_PATH` and `/usr/bin/env`.
- Warn about possible incompatibility with pre-packaged Ubuntu OpenJDKs
- Fix Gunpowder incompatability
- Add proper logging for the Taterwebz child instance

Introducing the Taterwebz, a browser embedded in Minecraft!

Added:
- **Taterwebz Block**
   - As of right now, **all browsers are client-side**, and things such as clicks and key input will not be sent to other clients.
   - Sync will be added in a future update (1.3.1).
- **Config Screen**
   - You can now configure a few things about the mod, such as the resolution of displays and VM arguments for inception games.

Changes:
- **Project Inception can now be run on servers!** Woohoo!
   - However, both inception games and browsers are handled client side.
   - This means that you won't be able to magically play the same world at the same time with this mod.
- **Disabled TechReborn recipes by default**
   - To re-enable, you'll need to edit the config file `project_inception.cfg` manually.

Known Bugs + Missing Features
- Certain actions might produce overlapping displays. Breaking both displays and rebuilding them, or just relogging, should fix this.
- Browsers do not sync across players (see above).
- PostLaunch's progress bar is compatible with [Dark Loading Screen](https://github.com/A5b84/dark-loading-screen) but not with [Splash](https://github.com/LoganDark/fabric-splash) yet.
- Some webgl-heavy webpages (eg [classic.minecraft.net](https://classic.minecraft.net)) do not work with the Taterwebz browsers
 
Technical:
- Added PostLaunch entrypoint
- Added [JCEF](https://github.com/chromiumembedded/java-cef) and [Pandomium](https://github.com/dzikoysk/pandomium). Should work on all platforms but untested for Mac and Linux right now.
- Refactored common display code
- Added a few more packets to QueueProtocol

**Tested with All of Fabric 3. Brought to you by questionable ASM transformations!**

Added basic inception functionality:
- Ability to spawn a game inside another
- Ability to spawn mulitple games
- Ability to interface with inner game

Added recipes:
- Vanilla & Techreborn versions
